kinds.note: Agents read issues and events: stack traces, the source lines around them, and tags.

operations.name: list_projects
operations.title: List projects
operations.description: List the Sentry projects you may read. To get the next page, repeat the call with identical arguments plus the returned next_cursor.

anyOf.description: Words in the project's name or slug.

operations.name: search_issues
operations.title: Search issues
operations.description: Search one Sentry project's issues (grouped errors) by status, level, environment and a phrase, most recently seen first by default. To get the next page, repeat the call with identical arguments plus the returned next_cursor.

project.description: A project's id or slug, from list_projects.
project.title: Project

anyOf.description: A phrase the issue's message or title contains; no quotes or backslashes.

status.description: Archived issues were once called ignored.
status.title: Status

period.description: Only issues with events in this period, counted back from now.
period.title: Period

operations.name: get_issue
operations.title: Get an issue
operations.description: Get a Sentry issue by id or short id: its status, counts, releases and tag names. Use get_issue_event for its stack trace.

issue.description: An issue's id, or its short id such as "WEB-1A3".
issue.title: Issue

operations.name: get_issue_event
operations.title: Get an issue's event
operations.description: Get one event of a Sentry issue, the latest by default: its exceptions with the innermost 40 stack frames and nearby source lines, tags, release, environment and runtime. Local variables, request headers and bodies, the user and breadcrumbs are left out.

issue.description: An issue's id, or its short id such as "WEB-1A3".
